title: NATS: Add tree item for each operation
description:
The hierarchy is now protocol (NATS) > operation (e.g. MSG) > operation fields.

This also allows the user to filter/search for an operation using `nats.<operation>`
which is a bit of syntactic sugar.

notes.body: I do not like this approach with hidden fields. Can you attach a sample capture file at some point so I can see how the current dissection works?

On first glance, I think I would prefer adding `proto_nats` to the tree once in `dissect_nats`, and if each PDU corresponds to a single operation (as it appears to), adding the `FT_NONE` for each operation as a subtree in `nats_get_or_create_proto_tree` rather than as hidden fields.

That seems to be a cleaner approach, yeah. Thanks for your suggestions 👍
I'll update the MR with these changes and also upload a sample capture.
